dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 家の中にいて、凄く辛いんです。
dialogue.content: Being at home is very hard for me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、どのような状況か詳しく聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me more about your situation?

dialogue.origin: 今、主人の両親と同居なんですが
dialogue.content: Right now, I'm living with my husband's parents.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 主人は、単身赴任で大阪にいて、主人の両親と私と子どもの4人で生活しています
dialogue.content: My husband is on a solo assignment in Osaka, so it's his parents, our child, and me—the four of us—living together.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはとても気を遣ってしまう感じですよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand. It sounds like you have to walk on eggshells.

dialogue.origin: はい。で、主人の両親が最悪で、本当に出て行きたいです
dialogue.content: Yes. And my husband's parents are the worst—I really want to move out.

dialogue.origin: それはとてもしんどいですよね、、
dialogue.content: That must be so difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご両親はどんなところが最悪だと感じておられますか？
dialogue.content: What is it about your husband's parents that you find so awful?

dialogue.origin: もともと、私と主人が結婚するの、反対だったらしくて、とにかく、冷たいです
dialogue.content: Apparently, they were against my husband and me getting married from the start, and they're just so cold to me.

dialogue.origin: 威張ってるし
dialogue.content: They're also very domineering.

dialogue.origin: 思いやりゼロです
dialogue.content: They have zero compassion.

dialogue.origin: 思いやりも感じられないのは、とても悲しくなってしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: It must be so sad to feel no compassion from them.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 例えばどんなふうに威張るのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In what ways are they domineering, for example?

dialogue.origin: 昔かたぎの父で、嫁にきたんだから、俺に従え、みたいな感じで、母も、黒でも白と言われたら白と言いなさいみたいな
dialogue.content: My father-in-law is very old-fashioned, with an attitude like, 'You're the bride who married into this family, so you will obey me.' And my mother-in-law is the type to say, 'If he says black is white, you say it's white.'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、なんだか上から押さえつけられている感じで、とても肩身が狭いですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you're being constantly put down, which must make you feel very small.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのことで夫さんには何か相談されたりしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to your husband about this?

dialogue.origin: はい。でも、今は仕方ない状況なので。
dialogue.content: Yes. But it's a situation that can't be helped right now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、仕方ない状況とはどういったことでしょうか（お話しできる範囲で結構です）
dialogue.content: I see. What do you mean by a situation that can't be helped? (Feel free to share only what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.origin: 子どもはまだ、生まれて2ヶ月なんですが、身体が弱くて、病院に通わないといけないんですが、主人の実家が病院に近いんです。それで、暫くはここにいるんです
dialogue.content: Our child is only 2 months old and has health issues, so we need to go to the hospital often. My husband's family home is close to the hospital, so we're staying here for a while.

dialogue.origin: でも、辛くて
dialogue.content: But it's so hard.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、生まれたばかりの赤ちゃんもおられて一人で頑張らないといけない状況はとてもつらいですよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand. Having to manage on your own with a newborn baby must be incredibly difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい。子どもが健康なら良かったんですが、障害を持って生まれたので。その事も、気に入らないのだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes. It would have been better if my child had been born healthy, but they were born with a disability. I think they don't like that either.

dialogue.origin: そんなことが・・・
dialogue.content: I’m so sorry to hear that.

dialogue.origin: うちにはこんな家系じゃないとか、母に言われました
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law told me things like, 'We don't have that in our family line.'

dialogue.origin: 関係ないんですけどね
dialogue.content: It has nothing to do with them, though.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、そんな家系とかは関係ないですし、生まれてきた大切な命をちゃんと受け入れてもらえないのはおても悲しいですよね
dialogue.content: You're right, family lines have nothing to do with it, and it must be so heartbreaking when they don't accept this precious new life.

dialogue.origin: ↑とても　です
dialogue.content: *very heartbreaking

dialogue.origin: 1番辛いの誰だって考える事も無いんでしょうね。
dialogue.content: I guess it never occurs to them who is suffering the most.

dialogue.origin: 主人も仕事が忙しいみたいで
dialogue.content: My husband seems to be busy with work, too.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 話を聞いてくれる時間がありません
dialogue.content: He doesn't have time to listen to me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは相談したとき何かおっしゃっていましたか？
dialogue.content: When you did talk to your husband, did he say anything?

dialogue.origin: 別に…頑張ってと
dialogue.content: Not really... Just, 'Hang in there.'

dialogue.origin: そんな反応だと悲しくなりますよね、、
dialogue.content: Hearing that kind of response can feel disheartening.

dialogue.origin: まだ、子どもに会ってないし、父親の感覚もないのかな、とか思ったりしています
dialogue.content: He hasn't even met the child yet, so I wonder if he doesn't have that fatherly feeling.

dialogue.origin: 仕方ないです
dialogue.content: It can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: 他に誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone else about this?

dialogue.origin: 無いです
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 相談しても仕方がないので
dialogue.content: Because talking about it won't change anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身のご両親との関わりとかはどんな感じなのでしょうか、話しにくい感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: How is your relationship with your own parents? Is it hard to talk to them about this?

dialogue.origin: そんな事はないんですが、余り心配をかけたく無いし、この感じは、話しても分からないと思います
dialogue.content: Not exactly, but I don't want to worry them too much, and I don't think they'd really understand what this feels like.

dialogue.origin: 暖かくないんですよ。全然
dialogue.content: There's no warmth. None at all.

dialogue.origin: 心配もかけたくないし、話しても分かってもらえないかと思うと、話しづらいですよね、、
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk about it when you don't want to worry them and you feel they might not understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 「暖かくない」というのはどういったことでしょうか
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'no warmth'?

dialogue.origin: 気持ちが冷たい、思いやりがない、って感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like they're emotionally cold, lacking compassion.

dialogue.origin: 優しい言葉とか、ないですもん
dialogue.content: There are no kind words or anything.

dialogue.origin: 励ましとかも
dialogue.content: No words of encouragement, either.

dialogue.origin: 障害を持ってる孫もいらないんでしょうね
dialogue.content: They probably don't even want a grandchild with a disability.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そう感じてしまうのも無理ないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Yes, it's completely understandable that you would feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 針のむしろです
dialogue.content: It's like sitting on pins and needles.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそうですよね、、
dialogue.content: It really must feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今は障害のこともあって病院が近いので実家におられるということですが
dialogue.content: Right now you're staying at your in-laws' because the hospital is nearby due to your child's disability, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 普段はご自身のお家は別にあるということでしょうか
dialogue.content: Do you normally have your own home somewhere else?

dialogue.origin: 大阪の主人がいる所です
dialogue.content: It's where my husband is, in Osaka.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今の実家は大阪からは遠いのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is your in-laws' current home far from Osaka?

dialogue.origin: 東京なので
dialogue.content: It's in Tokyo.

dialogue.origin: 主人も仕事が忙しくて、ずっと大阪です
dialogue.content: And my husband is busy with work, so he's always in Osaka.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、それは確かに孤独を感じてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: Yes, that would certainly make you feel very lonely.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 大阪の友人とかは連絡とったりはされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you keep in touch with any friends in Osaka?

dialogue.origin: 大阪には友人はいません。少し前に引っ越しをしたばかりなので
dialogue.content: I don't have any friends in Osaka. We just moved there a little while ago.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 以前に住んでおられたところのご友人とは連絡とられていますか？
dialogue.content: Do you keep in touch with friends from where you used to live?

dialogue.origin: このままだと自分のメンタルが心配です。
dialogue.content: If this keeps up, I'm worried about my own mental health.

dialogue.origin: あ、すみません
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ
dialogue.content: No, not at all.

dialogue.origin: 私は、余り友人がいなくて
dialogue.content: I... don't really have many friends.

dialogue.origin: メンタルがどうにかなってしまいそうで、怖いですよね、、
dialogue.content: It must be scary to feel like your mental health is at a breaking point.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お友達が少ない方なのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you don't have many friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仲良くされていたご友人とかはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone you used to be close to?

dialogue.origin: すみません。本当にいないんです。こんな話が出来る人が
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. I really don't have anyone. No one I can talk to about this.

dialogue.origin: 友人がいないって、私に問題があるんでしょうね
dialogue.content: Not having friends... there must be something wrong with me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、今日は勇気を出してお話に来てくれたんですね。有難うございます
dialogue.content: I see. It must have taken a lot of courage to come and talk today. Thank you for doing that.

dialogue.origin: ご友人が少ないからといって
dialogue.content: Just because you have few friends...

dialogue.origin: 問題があるとは私は思いません
dialogue.content: ...doesn't mean there's anything wrong with you, in my opinion.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。なんだか、もう、どうしていいか、分からなくて
dialogue.content: Thank you. I just... don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: 辛くて孤独です
dialogue.content: It's painful and I'm so lonely.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、今一人で障害をお持ちのお子さんを抱えて頑張られているのですものね
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. You're trying so hard, all by yourself, while caring for a child with a disability.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですけど…
dialogue.content: Yes, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes—what's on your mind?

dialogue.origin: いえ、何だか自信がないです。頑張らないいけないんですが
dialogue.content: No, it's just... I have no confidence. I know I have to keep trying, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 消えてしまいたくなる時があります
dialogue.content: Sometimes I just want to disappear.

dialogue.origin: 消えてしまいたくなる・・・そんなことが頭をよぎるのですね、、
dialogue.content: Feeling like disappearing... Those thoughts cross your mind.

dialogue.origin: だれも、気持ちを分かってくれません
dialogue.content: No one understands how I feel.

dialogue.origin: 辛いです
dialogue.content: It's painful.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 私はどうしたらいいでしょうか
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 私はあなたが少しでも気分が楽になってもらえたらいいと思うのですが
dialogue.content: Well, I would like to help you feel even a little bit better, if I can.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 普段、少しでも気を抜ける時間ってありますか？例えば、お買い物に出た時とか、なんでもいいのですが
dialogue.content: Do you ever have any time to relax, even for a little while? For example, when you go shopping, or anything at all.

dialogue.origin: 子どもを置いてはいけないし、連れても行けないし、お買い物とはないです。病院に行く位です
dialogue.content: I can't leave my child, and I can't take them with me, so I don't go shopping. The only time I go out is to the hospital.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、今の実家暮らしはどれくらいつづきそうか、見通しはありますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, do you have any idea how long you'll need to continue living at your in-laws' house?

dialogue.origin: 子どもの体調次第なんですが、最低後2ヶ月は…もしかしたら、もう少し長引くかもしれません
dialogue.content: It depends on my child's condition, but at least another two months... and it might be even longer.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況を少しでも変えていくために今から出来ることとして、一つはご実家を出る方法を検討してみるのもあると思いますし、あとは誰か少しでもお話しできそうな人はいないか思いめぐらせてみていただけたらいいと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: To begin making even small changes to your situation, one option could be to explore ways to move out of your in-laws' home, and another is to think about whether there might be anyone you could talk to, even a little. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。実家を出るのが1番なんですが、出来そうにないので、私の母にでも電話して話を聞いて貰います
dialogue.content: You're right. Leaving my in-laws' house would be best, but that doesn't seem possible right now. So, I'll try calling my own mother and have her listen to me.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、お母さまならきっとあなたの気持ちを受け止めてもらえると私も思います！
dialogue.content: That's a good idea. I'm sure your mother will be able to listen and understand your feelings!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: すみませんが、お時間になってしまいました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, but our time is up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: また、お母さまとお話されてどうだったかここでお聞かせいただけると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I would be happy to hear how your conversation with your mother goes, if you'd like to come back and talk about it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日のご相談はここでいったん終了とさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: Alright, we'll end our session for today.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日は勇気を出ししてご相談に来ていただき有難うございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for having the courage to come and speak with me today.

dialogue.origin: （時間オーバーすみません、、遅い時間までお疲れさまでした）
dialogue.content: (Sorry for going over time—thank you for staying with me so late.)

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.origin: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (Well then, I'll take my leave.)

topic.sub: 主人の両親との同居によるストレス
